author: Rabona
body:
Hey Guys!

I found this website, it is probably the best free IQ Tester there is out on the internet. If you are interested, take the test and tell us your scores! If you have already taken an IQ Test, just tell us your real score anyway!

The link is down below, but anyway, Happy Testing!
